Exact database hemolysis percentages at 10/50 ug/mL are preserved as source_conflict because local primary material has Figure 8 image/caption/prose but no embedded point table.
CAMP CAMPSQ24526 aggregates multiple C12/C14/C16 activity strings under Undefined/FXXL and is not normalized to one source entity.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local primary material contains Figure 8 as a plotted image plus caption/prose, but no embedded data table for exact database hemolysis percentages at 10 and 50 ug/mL. Exact graph points were not digitized or promoted to source_verified.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact DBAASP hemolysis percentage rows remain source_conflict; supported toxicity prose/range records are retained and the paper is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.
